name: Claymation
description: Edits the photo to restyle it as a handmade claymation scene with visible fingerprints in the clay.
aliases: restyle it as a handmade claymation scene with visible fingerprints in the clay

prompt.default: Edit the image to restyle it as a handmade claymation scene with visible fingerprints in the clay. Keep the composition and subject identical.
prompt.local-wan: A handmade plasticine miniature scene, with rounded clay forms, thumbprints and tiny sculpted details across every surface. The image layout is rebuilt entirely from colored clay under soft miniature-set lighting.
